prompts.name: vfx-food
prompts.prompt: Generate a NEW independent production ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for premium 16-bit pixel-art Mushroom Snake. Transparent background, no text, labels or grid lines. SIX equally spaced frames, exact 3 columns by 2 rows, square 512x512 conceptual slots on 1536x1024 canvas, every effect centered in its slot, generous fully transparent margins so no cell crosses its boundary. Frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Crisp clustered stepped pixel art, no blurred halos or bloom, no 3D, no vector outlines. Restrained short bounded effects, not a generic radial dot circle. FOOD impact sequence: frame1 tiny ivory four-point sparkle, frame2 warm gold asymmetric initial seed-shaped flash, frame3 brilliant ivory central glint with five jagged golden shards streaming UP and diagonally LEFT, frame4 shards spread and trail smaller stepped pixels, frame5 sparse gold sparks fade, frame6 nearly gone two tiny glints. Never a circular ring; no food object or text. Gold/ivory signature.
